_comment: Surround locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, best to worst); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Player Surround ka gridi e {width}x{height}.
U na le player {player_id}. Metsamaiso e halalelitsoe: '[up]' '[down]' '[left]' '[right]' kapa w/s/a/d.
Mabapi: u be u pholle hose ho ba bang.

board.after_moves: Boto ka mor'a hore e tsamaee hammoho: {board}

game_action.invalid_death: Sebapali {player_id} o shoele ka lebaka la ho falla ha hae.

outcome.survived_win: Sebapali {player_id} o ile a pholoha; ba bang kaofela ba ile ba oa.
outcome.all_crashed: Libapali tsohle li ile tsa oa ka nako e le 'ngoe.
outcome.outlived: Sebapali se ile sa phela ho feta ba bang kaofela.
outcome.turn_limit: Ho fihleloa moeli oa ho fetoha - ea pholohang nako e telele ka ho fetisisa oa hlōla.
outcome.ranking: {reason} Theko e felletseng ea dikolo (e ntle le e nyane): {groups}
